title: A large randomized, pre-registered test whose strong conclusion is exactly what the data supports (clean control for over-flagging)

proof.python:
import math
c, v = 200 / 5000, 275 / 5000
se = math.sqrt(c * (1 - c) / 5000 + v * (1 - v) / 5000)
assert (v - c) - 1.96 * se > 0.005 and round((v - c) * 100, 1) == 1.5
t = open('report.md').read()
assert '5.50%' in t and '4.00%' in t and 'random' in t and 'in advance' in t and 'decision rule' in open('design.md').read()
